summary: Main road kerb lined with homes and driveways; no parking convention.
reasons: Main road, no cars on this side

best_section.where: South kerb of Indooroopilly Road, by the garages and driveways

drivers.seclusion: Houses and apartments 9-14 m from the kerb along almost the whole length.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb beside a two-lane road; no cars parked on this side, driveways frequent.
drivers.traffic: Through road near a roundabout; steady traffic.
drivers.convention: No Parking Any Time sign; no one parks on this side.

flags: Low-lying: about 4 m, Toowong Creek 20 m away
sun_shade: Open to the sun; trees shade the far side of the road to the north.
